items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: The interviewee identifies Louis Armstrong as 'Papa' and discusses his band and anecdotes about him, but does not state they met or worked together personally. The mention of 'called Louis' refers to a third party (Frank Frobe) summoning Armstrong, not the interviewee.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. He knew you were in trouble.

That was my introduction to Dizzy. But then I got to know him a little later. We were working at Roundtable in New York and Tyree Glenn had the band that was alternating with us. And Dizzy and he used to, Dizzy would come in there and they would talk a lot. Dizzy had a little round ass, like a potent type. No, not a beret. No, this is like a potent type where he's in the shrine. And he was going to go over to some little country over in Africa. And he was going to be the prime minister over there. Like Louis…
It didn't work out, though, apparently.

items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I used to go back to sit in with him all the time. And they're in the same place, the Ritz, they had a color band, and I used to go sit in there with him.

ctx.x: Now here's another thing. When he died, Bill, this is the God's truth, so help me. So help me. When he died, there was two things that his mother had. And if I'd only got them, you see, Louie disputed me about him and them and having a bucket contest on the boat.
